name: Beijing Shunxin Agriculture Co.,Ltd
summary: Beijing Shunxin Agriculture Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the brewing, production, and sale of liquor products under the Niulanshan and Ningcheng brand names in China. It is also involved in the breeding and farming of pigs; provision of commercial pigs under the Xiaodian brand, and fresh and cooked food products under the Pengcheng brand; livestock, poultry, and meat slaughtering; meat and meat by-product processing; animal husbandry; feed processing; paper product processing and production; planting; wholesale and retail of pre-packaged and bulk food; cooperation with farmers to raise pics and provide supporting services; research and development of pig breeding techn…
